metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear enemy forgot how to play Valorant LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did that really just count?
Enemy must’ve been daydreaming mid-fight.
If your aim’s trash but you still get kills, you know the feeling.
Valorant logic doing its usual weird thing.

Tap if your best plays look like accidents too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
